chunks: Those who did not believe and rejected Our signs and the meeting in the Hereafter, will be given over to punishment.

key_terms.وَلِقَاءِ الْآخِرَةِ: And the meeting in the Hereafter

ai.seo_question: Who are the people destined for punishment according to this verse?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse from Surah Ar-Rum underscores the inevitability of divine accountability for those who deny both the clear signs (ayat) and the resurrection (liqa' al-akhirah). It serves as a stern warning that disbelief is not merely a passive state but an active rejection that ensures their presence before God for retribution, a theme often linked to the concept of 'hadr' (being brought forth) in eschatological discussions.
